documents.text:
SERVICES AGREEMENT (fictional)

This Agreement is made between Harrowgate Systems Inc. (the Supplier) and Voss-Lindqvist AB (the Customer).

2. Term
2.1 This Agreement starts on 1 March 2026 and continues for three (3) years.
2.2 It renews for successive one-year periods unless either party gives notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the term.

4. Fees
4.1 The Customer shall pay the fees set out in Schedule 1.
4.2 The Customer shall pay each invoice within thirty (30) days of its date.

9. Liability
9.1 Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to EUR 1,000,000.
9.2 Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss.

12. Termination
12.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of notice.
12.2 The Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience on ninety (90) days' written notice.

15. Governing law
15.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of Sweden.

facts.fact: termination for convenience on 90 days' notice

documents.name: Transcript - Settlement call (fictional).md
documents.text:
# Transcript — Settlement call

Meeting M-101 · client call · transcribed verbatim; corrections are marked in the record.

Participants: Alice Hart (attorney); Petra Voss (client)

[10:02:13] Alice Hart: The supplier has offered to settle the invoice dispute.

[10:02:58] Petra Voss: What exactly are they offering?

[10:03:40] Alice Hart: They offer to pay EUR 40,000 by 30 November in full settlement, with no admission of liability.

[10:05:12] Petra Voss: We can accept that if they also extend the service credits to the end of the year.

[10:06:30] Alice Hart: I will send a counter-proposal to their counsel by Friday.

[10:07:05] Petra Voss: Agreed. Please copy our finance director.

facts.fact: the offer of EUR 40,000 by 30 November
the client's condition: service credits extended
